description_html: Role Overview     The    Enterprise Architecture Manager    is a strategic senior technical leader responsible for defining, directing, and governing the enterprise target state architecture, technology portfolio lifecycle, and modernization roadmap across Citi's global technology estate.    In this role, you will lead the transformation of application architecture governance, software and infrastructure inventory management, data analytics capabilities, and the operationalization of next-generation enterprise AI patterns. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, enterprise architecture, and emerging AI technologies, you will partner with senior technology, risk, compliance, and business leaders to drive enterprise-wide modernization programs, elevate data quality, mitigate technical debt, and ensure continuous regulatory and audit readiness.     Key Responsibilities      1. Enterprise Architecture Governance & Strategic Modernization       Target State Architecture (TSA) & Blueprints:    Define, govern, and maintain the Enterprise Target State Architecture, Transition Roadmaps, and Reference Architectures across all domains:    Business, Data, Application, Technology, and Security (BDATS)   .     Architecture Governance Framework:    Operationalize Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), establish enterprise Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and enforce adherence to standard frameworks (e.g.,    TOGAF 10, BIAN   ).     Application & Infrastructure Portfolio Management (APM):    Oversee global application inventory, software asset lifecycles, and CMDB data fidelity to eliminate architectural debt, manage obsolescence, and support cloud migration and legacy modernization initiatives.     Root Cause & Impact Analysis:    Conduct in-depth technical investigations, Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and structural impact assessments on core operating platforms to engineer proactive systemic guardrails.      2. Multi-Agent Systems, Autonomous Engineering & AI Architecture       Autonomous AI & Developer Platforms (Devin AI / AI Engineering):    Architect and integrate autonomous software engineering agents and AI coding platforms (e.g.,    Devin AI   , GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, Claude Code) into the enterprise Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), establishing secure sandboxing, verification pipelines, architectural compliance gates, and automated code review guardrails.     Agentic Orchestration & Patterns:    Architect enterprise-grade pattern-based multi-agent systems utilizing frameworks such as Salesforce Agentic Architecture, LangGraph/AutoGen, and    Agent-to-Agent (A2A)    orchestration patterns (Supervisor-Worker, Hierarchical Planning, ReAct).     Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration:    Define and implement    Model Context Protocol (MCP)    standards and secure tool-calling interfaces to decouple LLMs and autonomous agents from backend enterprise services, databases, and microservices.     Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Ontologies:    Architect    Enterprise Architecture Knowledge Graphs (EAKG)    using open semantic ontologies (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL) and    GraphRAG    (hybrid vector + graph retrieval) to anchor AI outputs to verified enterprise metadata and maintain portable, auditable corporate knowledge.     Hardware & Compute Strategy:    Modernize procurement and resource allocation workflows for specialized AI/accelerator infrastructure (GPUs, TPUs, hybrid inference clusters).      3. Quantitative Architecture Analytics, SQL & Portfolio Modeling       Advanced SQL & Relational Data Analytics:    Design and execute complex SQL queries (multi-table joins, window functions, CTEs, recursive queries) across enterprise CMDBs, APMs, data lakes, and transactional stores to interrogate architecture health, system dependencies, and technical risk metrics.     Advanced MS Excel Modeling & Reporting:    Build sophisticated executive analytical models, interactive dashboards, and portfolio capacity/financial plans in    MS Excel    utilizing    Power Query, Power Pivot.      Data Quality & Metrics Framework:    Formulate Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to gauge application health, cloud readiness, tech debt retirement, and regulatory compliance.      4. AI Trust, Risk, Governance & Regulatory Compliance       AI TRiSM & Guardrails Architecture:    Establish comprehensive AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM) controls, deploying deterministic guardrails against prompt injection, model evasion, data poisoning, hallucination, and sensitive data leakage (PII/MNPI).     Model Monitoring & Observability:    Implement enterprise observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry, OpenInference) to track agent execution traces, latency budgets, token consumption, and continuous    model/semantic drift   .     Regulatory Alignment:    Ensure enterprise systems comply with global financial regulatory mandates, including    Model Risk Management (SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12)   ,    BCBS 239    data governance/lineage standards,    DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)   , and global AI statutory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF).      5. Leadership, Stakeholder Influence & Operational Excellence       Team Leadership & Resource Management:    Lead, mentor, and allocate work across a high-performing team of enterprise, solution, and domain architects.     Executive Stakeholder Diplomacy:    Guide, influence, and negotiate technical strategy with senior executives, line-of-business heads, control functions, and internal/external auditors.     Risk & Ethics Custodianship:    Appropriately assess risk in all architectural decisions, safeguarding Citigroup's reputation, assets, and clients by enforcing transparent control issue reporting and sound ethical conduct.      Required Technical Competencies & Architectural Concepts      Enterprise & Distributed Systems Architecture (Must-Have)       Frameworks & Methodologies:    TOGAF, BIAN (Banking Industry Architecture Network), Zachman, ArchiMate, Domain-Driven Design (DDD: Bounded Contexts, Domain Events, Ubiquitous Language).     Distributed Architecture Paradigms:    Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), CQRS, Event Sourcing, CAP Theorem, zero-trust security architecture, microservices decomposition, and polyglot persistence.     Resilience & Scalability Patterns:    Circuit Breaker, Bulkhead, Transactional Outbox, Rate Limiting, Active-Active multi-region topologies, and zero-downtime deployment patterns.      Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Agents & Agentic Engineering (Must-Have)       Autonomous AI Engineering (Devin AI):    Architecture patterns for autonomous developer agents (Devin AI, agentic CI/CD integration, self-healing code pipelines, sandbox isolation, and automated architectural rule validation).     Agentic Paradigms:    Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocols, autonomous task decomposition, ReAct reasoning, and reflection loops.     Integration Protocols:    Model Context Protocol (MCP), Function Calling / Tool Abstractions, OpenAPI/gRPC agent integrations.      Data Analysis, SQL & Business Intelligence (Must-Have)       Intermediate SQL:    Complex querying, analytical window functions.     Advanced MS Excel & Analytics:    Expert proficiency with Power Query (ETL/M-code), Power Pivot, and executive dashboard visualization.      Qualifications       Experience:    10+ years of progressive experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solutions Architecture, or Technology Strategy within complex global environments.     Domain Background:    Substantial experience in Financial Services or highly regulated, large-scale, matrixed enterprise environments preferred.     Autonomous AI & Modernization Delivery:    Proven track record leading architectural transformation, autonomous/agentic AI tool adoption (e.g., Devin AI), and enterprise application portfolio modernization.     Quantitative & Analytical Rigor:    Demonstrated mastery in data-driven decision making using advanced SQL data extraction, statistical benchmarking, and sophisticated MS Excel modeling.     Executive Communication:    Superior written and verbal diplomacy skills with proven ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs, analytical insights, and AI paradigms to non-technical, C-level, and regulatory audiences.      Education & Certifications       Education:    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).     Advanced Degree:    Master’s degree (M.S., M.Eng., or MBA) preferred.     Preferred Certifications:    TOGAF Certified, BIAN Certified, Cloud Solutions Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Microsoft Certified Data Analyst / Power BI, or equivalent AI/ML architecture credentials.                  ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Infrastructure            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $156,160.00 - $234,240.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at NVIDIA is an engineering discipline focused on designing, building, and operating large-scale production systems with exceptional efficiency, resilience, and availability. It combines software and systems engineering practices with deep expertise across distributed systems, networking, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, capacity management, continuous delivery, and observability. SRE at NVIDIA ensures that our internal and external services achieve their reliability and performance objectives while enabling developers to deliver changes safely and rapidly. Our engineers automate repetitive operational work, improve system performance, build scalable platforms, and continuously strengthen the reliability of production environments.   As a Principal SRE, you will shape the technical direction of NVIDIA’s AI Platform Runtime and lead reliability engineering initiatives spanning multiple organizations. You will solve complex, ambiguous problems at enterprise scale, establish architectural standards, and influence how teams design and operate critical AI-powered services. You will also advance the use of AI agents and skills to transform platform operations and developer productivity. Our SRE culture values intellectual curiosity, diversity of thought, collaboration, and learning through blameless analysis. We encourage engineers to think boldly, take thoughtful risks, and lead meaningful improvements across organizational boundaries.    What you’ll be doing:    Define and drive the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for reliability across NVIDIA’s AI Platform Runtime and related enterprise systems.  Architect highly available, resilient, secure, and scalable distributed platforms that power NVIDIA’s next-generation AI-driven products and services.  Lead the design and development of AI agents, AI skills, and intelligent automation that accelerate platform operations, incident response, troubleshooting, and remediation.  Establish platform-wide reliability standards, including service-level objectives, error budgets, capacity models, resilience patterns, and operational readiness requirements.  Identify systemic risks and lead cross-functional programs that improve availability, scalability, performance, security, and developer productivity.  Advance observability across complex distributed environments through OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, profiling, analytics, and automated anomaly detection.  Partner with senior leaders and engineers across Cloud, Platform, Security, Networking, and AI/ML organizations to make high-impact architectural and investment decisions.  Provide technical leadership during critical incidents and ensure that lessons from incidents translate into durable engineering and organizational improvements.  Develop reference architectures, shared platform capabilities, and automation frameworks that can be adopted across multiple engineering organizations.  Influence, mentor, and raise the technical bar for senior engineers and technical leaders throughout the company.     What we need to see:    15+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, Cloud Architecture, or related infrastructure engineering roles.  BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field involving significant software development, or equivalent experience.  Demonstrated experience setting technical strategy and leading large-scale engineering initiatives across multiple teams or organizations.  Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, networking, Linux, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.  Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Java, with experience building production-grade automation and platform software.  Extensive experience with infrastructure-as-code and platform automation technologies such as Terraform, Crossplane, AWS CDK, AWS CloudFormation, or equivalent tools.  Deep understanding of observability at scale, including OpenTelemetry and modern metrics, logging, tracing, profiling, and analytics platforms.  Expertise in reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives, error budgets, capacity planning, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, incident management, and blameless postmortems.  A track record of delivering measurable improvements in availability, performance, operational efficiency, or engineering productivity within complex environments.  Outstanding technical judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across technical and organizational boundaries.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience designing or operating large-scale AI/ML platforms, GPU infrastructure, inference systems, training environments, or high-performance computing platforms.  Hands-on experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or intelligent automation for infrastructure and production operations.  Demonstrated success establishing reliability architecture and engineering standards adopted across a large enterprise.  Experience applying machine learning, analytics, or advanced automation to capacity management, anomaly detection, incident response, or autonomous remediation.  Recognized technical leadership through patents, publications, open-source contributions, industry standards, conference presentations, or widely adopted internal platforms.    NVIDIA is leading groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work creates new possibilities for exploration, creativity, and discovery, powering innovations that once belonged to science fiction—from artificial intelligence to autonomous vehicles. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional technical leaders like you to help architect the reliable platforms that will accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.   #LI-Hybrid                You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Solutions Architect - Digital Native Business (Geo)
Senior Web Application Security Engineer
description_html:
Headquarters: Armenia, Belarus, Georgia
URL: http://epam.com

We are looking for an experienced Senior Web Application Security Engineer to join and support the client's security team. The specialist will work closely with the broader security team, covering key areas of web application protection and security operations.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, tune and maintain Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules and policies using Akamai
  • Participate in security incident handling, investigation and resolution related to web application threats
  • Conduct reviews of WAF configurations, security policies and web application security posture
  • Identify and analyze attack patterns, anomalies and vulnerabilities targeting web applications
  • Provide day-to-day support to the security team, sharing expertise and best practices in web app security
  • Support integration of security processes across the broader team environment

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Akamai (WAF, Kona Site Defender or similar Akamai security products)
  • Knowledge of web application security concepts such as OWASP Top 10, DDoS mitigation and bot management
  • Experience with WAF rule tuning, false positive management and security incident response
  • Capability to work independently and integrate quickly into an existing team
  • Proficiency in English communication skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with other WAF/CDN platforms such as Cloudflare, F5 and Imperva
  • Familiarity with API security
  • Security certifications (CISSP, CEH, GWAPT etc.)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-web-application-security-engineer
